item: Unverified third-party market prices were used in edges and candidate selection. Official links alone did not verify inputs.
resolution: All market prices, EV and eligible selections blank. Exact operator quote, timestamp and settlement rules required.

item: CONDITIONAL injury gate was accepted as PASS. Missing current availability cannot support a selection.
resolution: Strict PASS-only engine. Availability remains blocked; no candidate is recommended.

item: Cross-team passing/scoring correlation was used as same-game bet correlation. These are different observational units.
resolution: Bet-leg correlation blank. Require paired pregame residuals and threshold-specific joint outcome calibration.

item: Model home winning margin and sportsbook home handicap used incompatible signs; model minus handicap was not a valid edge.
resolution: Use home handicap = negative projected home margin. Expected cover margin = predicted margin + quoted handicap. No price edge published.

item: Blanket 2.5-point home advantage applied to the CIN–ATL Madrid international game.
resolution: Madrid label rechecked. Baseline uses zero home adjustment everywhere (design, not estimated fact); neutral game override tested.

item: Leaderboard ranked strategies in array order and filled realized points with zero without a settled ledger. Claimed automated grading was not implemented.
resolution: Ranks, returns, scores, confidence intervals and rewards blank. Unit-tested settlement primitives exist; no claim of a live ingestion/grading service.

item: Two matching session captures and arithmetic checks were described as source verification. No immutable original-page captures accompany legacy data.
resolution: Quarantine all legacy rows. Selected standings, schedule and NGS fields independently checked on 2026-11-04; transcribed excerpts and hashes retained, not raw HTML.

item: README/source registry assumed Netherlands jurisdiction without evidence. Repository content does not establish legal residency or wagering eligibility.
resolution: Replace legal claims with Washington regulator guidance; no assumption that remote mobile wagering is permitted.

item: No multi-season, time-stamped game/player training ledger, official operator quotes or untouched holdout dataset is available in the repo.
resolution: All strategies remain research-only. No validated skill, profitable edge, cash reward or future autonomous collection is claimed.

item: Legacy kickoff labels asserted ET although the retrieved schedule shows LOCAL; venue names were not independently confirmed here.
resolution: Verified schedule publishes matchups/dates only; kickoff timezone and venue blank. Legacy rows retained in audit inventory, not live facts.

item: External-host allowlisting was called link verification; it does not prove HTTP reachability or factual support. Multiple old HTML trees could expose stale assertions.
resolution: New deployment artifact excludes historical trees. Internal paths, fragments, official links per row and HTTPS are checked. External fetch results scoped separately; not every external destination was fetched.

item: Single-season correlations and arbitrary edge/stake cutoffs cannot remove luck or establish selective skill.
resolution: Replace claims with preregistered walk-forward, clustered uncertainty, multiple-testing correction and untouched holdout requirements. Thresholds are explicit project policy, not official facts.

item: GitHub integration returns HTTP 403 when changing Pages publishing mode; this session cannot enable custom-workflow deployment.
resolution: Reuse existing main/root Pages deployment. Jekyll exclusion config keeps legacy trees out of publication; CI separately validates the isolated artifact. No user credentials or manual changes requested.

item: Concurrent sessions published additional reviews and partial Week 9 injury captures after this checkout baseline.
resolution: Preserved all concurrent source files and board history. Independently confirmed Week 9 report exists, plus limited selected observations. No Injuries Reported is not final availability clearance. Historical audit diagnostics remain in Git, not the new site.
